test: Does the unexplained 2003 shortfall carry the geographic signature of a northern-origin biotic driver?
discriminator: Buckthorn, the soybean aphid overwintering host, is concentrated north of 41 N (Tilmon et al., JIPM 2011).
verdict: NOT SUPPORTED. The northern concentration in 2003 is explained by climate. The residual shows no latitude gradient, the north-south residual gap has the wrong sign, and there is no aphid-era shift. 2003 remains the largest unexplained shortfall, but its geography is not diagnostic of a northern-origin driver.
